description: This Java class 'AnalyticsService' provides AI-driven analytics functionalities such as overall insights and employee-specific insights based on performance metrics. It interacts with repository classes to retrieve data and performs statistical calculations to generate summaries, trends, and top performer listings.

classes.name: AnalyticsService
classes.description: Service class providing analytics methods for overall and employee-specific insights based on performance metrics.

methods.name: overallInsights
methods.description: Generates overall performance insights over a specified number of days, including metric averages, top performers, and a summary.

methods.name: employeeInsights
methods.description: Generates insights for a specific employee over a specified period, including averages and trend analysis.

methods.name: computeTrend
methods.description: Calculates the trend ('IMPROVING', 'DECLINING', 'STABLE', or 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA') of performance based on a series of values.

methods.name: buildInsightSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string highlighting the best metric and top performers.
